description: Maziman wears a long warm brown open-front coat with narrow gold geometric embroidered borders along the front edges, cuffs and lower hem. Beneath it is a cream lightweight full-length tunic or robe, with decorated neckline and fine matching trim. A broad woven burgundy, brown and gold sash circles the waist and hangs down the front with a fringed end. The coat sleeves hang loosely around the wrists. Brown leather ankle boots are visible beneath the cream robe. His head is uncovered, and the ensemble contains no armor, weapon, crown, veil or ceremonial regalia.
